Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && python3 -c "
import struct

with open('poc_font', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# The first 4 bytes are sfVersion (Fixed 16.16)
sfVersion = struct.unpack('>I', data[0:4])[0]
print(f'sfVersion: {sfVersion:#x}')
# numTables is at offset 4
numTables = struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
print(f'numTables: {numTables}')
# searchRange at offset 6
searchRange = struct.unpack('>H', data[6:8])[0]
print(f'searchRange: {searchRange}')
# entrySelector at offset 8
entrySelector = struct.unpack('>H', data[8:10])[0]
print(f'entrySelector: {entrySelector}')
# rangeShift at offset 10
rangeShift = struct.unpack('>H', data[10:12])[0]
print(f'rangeShift: {rangeShift}')
"
